strings.name: Liu Yonghao
strings.role: Chair of New Hope Group; Vice Chair of China Minsheng Bank
strings.summary: Liu Yonghao is a Chinese agribusiness entrepreneur who began a business with his brothers in 1982 and later developed New Hope's feed, livestock and related operations. He participates in bank governance and has long engaged with private enterprise and rural development. His business succession requires distinguishing the group, listed company New Hope Liuhe, and his roles as a director and controlling person.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026. Uses 1951 as his birth year; distinguishes the group and listed company, leaving a board and relinquishing control, and charitable plans and verified results.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded New Hope Group, advancing animal feed, agricultural industrialization and private enterprise in China.
strings.facts.f1.label: Corporate boundaries
strings.facts.f1.value: New Hope Group and listed New Hope Liuhe are separate entities; leaving the latter's board in 2025 did not mean leaving the group chairmanship.
strings.facts.f2.label: Bank position
strings.facts.f2.value: Minsheng Bank disclosures identify him as Vice Chair and a non-executive director, distinct from the bank president and day-to-day management roles.
strings.highlights.h1.title: From joint enterprise to agribusiness
strings.highlights.h1.text: Expanded into feed and agribusiness after starting a business with his brothers; the 1982 entrepreneurial beginning is not the incorporation date of today's group legal entity.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Business succession and rural engagement
strings.highlights.h2.text: The listed company's chairmanship transition and his board departure occurred in different years; he continued participating in rural training activities as group chair.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Teaches rural leadership trainees
strings.timeline.t1.text: Shared agricultural business and training experience and spoke with participants at the opening of the sixth rural revitalization village-leader course.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Attends Minsheng Bank board meeting
strings.timeline.t2.text: Participated by telephone or video link as Vice Chair, contributing to collective governance.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Leaves New Hope Liuhe's board
strings.timeline.t3.text: The annual report records departure at the end of his term during board renewal; this did not remove his group chairmanship or controlling-person status for the reporting period.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Proposes clearing arrears to private firms
strings.timeline.t4.text: At the national Two Sessions, proposed improving the business environment and clearing government arrears to private firms; these were proposals.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Hands over listed-company chairmanship
strings.timeline.t5.text: Liu Chang became Chair and Chen Chunhua Co-Chair; Liu Yonghao remained group Chair and a director of the listed company.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Participates in the Guangcai initiative
strings.timeline.t6.text: Joined other private entrepreneurs in proposing industrial investment as a means of poverty alleviation.
strings.timeline.t7.title: First attends the Two Sessions as a CPPCC member
strings.timeline.t7.text: Spoke at the national political consultative conference about private enterprise development.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Starts a business with his brothers
strings.timeline.t8.text: The four brothers began an agricultural business, laying the groundwork for the later Hope-related enterprises.
